title: Stepping out with the bowler bag

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. Candid paparazzi frame at dusk: she steps out of the back of a black car onto the pavement, the cherry-red bowler bag swinging from one hand toward camera, her gaze past the lens. She wears a black double-breasted blazer dress, sheer black tights and black pointed slingback heels. Direct on-camera flash mixed with blue dusk ambient, 35mm, framed from head to shoes, the car door edge soft in the foreground.
